biotools.summary: 3d-OT is a deep geometry-aware framework designed for aligning heterogeneous slices in spatial multi-omics data. It utilizes soft correspondence optimal transport to handle nonrigid deformations and enables the construction of 3D spatiotemporal developmental trajectories.
